title: Detailed watermelon slice
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='rind' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#3ddc84'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1a8f4c'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='flesh' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5a7a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e6203f'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- outer rind: half-disc, flat side up -->
  <path d='M8 32 A42 42 0 0 0 92 32 Z' fill='url(#rind)'/>

  <!-- white pith band -->
  <path d='M13 32 A37 37 0 0 0 87 32 Z' fill='#f4fff5'/>

  <!-- red flesh -->
  <path d='M16 32 A34 34 0 0 0 84 32 Z' fill='url(#flesh)'/>

  <!-- inner glow highlight on flesh -->
  <path d='M20 32 A30 30 0 0 0 80 32 Z' fill='#ff8fa3' opacity='0.35'/>

  <!-- seeds -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='42' rx='2.2' ry='3' fill='#2b1030' transform='rotate(-18 33 42)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='2.2' ry='3' fill='#2b1030'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='42' rx='2.2' ry='3' fill='#2b1030' transform='rotate(18 67 42)'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='54' rx='2' ry='2.8' fill='#3a1440' transform='rotate(-28 30 54)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='2' ry='2.8' fill='#3a1440'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='54' rx='2' ry='2.8' fill='#3a1440' transform='rotate(28 70 54)'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='59' rx='1.8' ry='2.5' fill='#2b1030' transform='rotate(-10 40 59)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='59' rx='1.8' ry='2.5' fill='#2b1030' transform='rotate(10 60 59)'/>

  <!-- seed highlights -->
  <circle cx='32.4' cy='40.8' r='0.7' fill='#ffc2cf'/>
  <circle cx='49.4' cy='36.8' r='0.7' fill='#ffc2cf'/>
  <circle cx='66.4' cy='40.8' r='0.7' fill='#ffc2cf'/>
  <circle cx='49.4' cy='48.8' r='0.7' fill='#ffc2cf'/>
  <circle cx='29.4' cy='52.8' r='0.6' fill='#ffc2cf'/>
  <circle cx='69.4' cy='52.8' r='0.6' fill='#ffc2cf'/>
</svg>
